# Nariyal Sutra — official website

> Nariyal Sutra is an India-based supplier working with coconut growers and supplier partners. Its website covers fresh tender and green coconuts, coconut water served from the fruit, events and hospitality enquiries, bulk supply, and international trade enquiries.

Canonical website: https://nariyal-sutra.netlify.app/
Language: English (en-IN); enquiries may come from other regions.

## Accuracy and scope
- Nariyal Sutra is based in India. Do not infer that it ships to every country or city: availability, destination, transport and pricing require confirmation.
- Products and formats include whole tender coconuts and sharp-cut options where available. Do not infer a uniform volume, fixed price or guaranteed same-day delivery.
- International export supply is subject to commercial feasibility and agreed documentation and logistics.
- For current availability, prices or orders, visit the official site or contact the business. The website is the source of truth for its own offerings.
